- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and communicate technical concepts clearly.

- Experience building data-driven shopping experiences and simulating consumer journeys.

- High attention to detail and a collaborative mindset for working with cross-functional teams.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Previous involvement with AI, machine learning, or data annotation projects.

- Background in creating advanced metadata structures or contributing to AI training initiatives.

 Join a team supporting physical AI projects by collecting high-quality data from real-world human movement and manipulation. Your recordings and task evaluations will help train embodied AI systems to interact with the physical world.
 What You'll Do

- Operate robots through teleoperation using VR controllers or leader arms while data is recorded.

- Capture clear egocentric task footage with head-mounted cameras.

- Perform and document hands-on tasks such as folding, sorting, assembling, and cooking.

- Set up and operate motion capture and sensor systems, including motion capture cameras, IMUs, and LiDAR.

- Film, photograph, and scan physical spaces, work areas, and objects for scene data.

- Evaluate robot performance on assigned tasks and score results.

 What We're Looking For

- Zero to five years of experience in robotics operations, teleoperation, motion capture, VFX, camera or drone operation, laboratory work, autonomous vehicle testing, or skilled trades.

- Experience operating physical equipment or sensors with careful, repeatable technique, such as robots, camera rigs, drones, motion capture systems, test vehicles, or precision tools.

- Ability to follow written capture protocols and accurately log each recording.

- Familiarity with ROS or ROS 2, VR controllers, leader-follower teleoperation, OptiTrack or Vicon, IMUs, LiDAR, GoPro, or head-mounted cameras is helpful.

- Ability to complete projects at home or work with provided equipment, or travel for on-site projects.

 Compensation & Benefits
 Compensation is $20 to $40 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is based on hours worked.
 Location
 Remote projects are available, with some assignments requiring on-site work. Some projects can be completed from home or your workplace using provided equipment.
 Compensation Range: $41.6K - $83.2K

Customer Service Executive — uPhone
 uPhone · Fully remote (work from anywhere) · Full-time · Apply to 
 Posted 18 November 2026 · Open until 17 January 2027
 Fully remote — work from anywhere in the world, with no country restriction. Compensation is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
 About uPhone
 uPhone is an eSIM marketplace built for modern travellers, available at (). The service is operated by Targa Limited, a company registered in Hong Kong. The team is small, remote-first, and based across Europe and Asia.
 uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
 What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract.
 uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service.
 Company values, as stated on the About Us page: transparency (what you see is what you pay), simplicity (purchase to connected in under two minutes), reliability (24/7 support and a clear refund policy), and sustainability (digital eSIMs mean zero plastic waste).
 The role
 We are hiring a Customer Service Executive to be a frontline point of contact for travellers using uPhone eSIM.
 You will help customers choose a plan, install their eSIM, troubleshoot connection issues, and understand refunds and top-ups — over live chat and email. Many conversations happen just before a flight or just after landing, so clear, accurate, and calm help matters. This is a fully remote, full-time role — you can work from anywhere in the world. Support is published as 24/7, with a typical response time under two minutes, so this role includes shift work. That may include evenings, nights, weekends, or public holidays, as agreed with the team.
 You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to follow documentation, explain technical steps in plain language, and know when to escalate.
 Responsibilities
 - Respond to customer questions on live chat and email within the team's service standards, aiming to protect the published typical response time of under two minutes.
 - Help travellers choose an appropriate country, regional, or global plan (including unlimited and longer-stay monthly or yearly options) and explain what is included: uPhone plans are data-only; the physical SIM and home number can stay in the phone; calls and texts go through apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage.
 - Walk customers through purchase, QR-code delivery, installation on iPhone and Android, and when to activate (profiles can be installed before travel; data should usually be turned on at the destination so validity starts when it is needed).
 - Troubleshoot common issues using the documented playbooks: device compatibility, carrier locks, APN settings, activation delays (typically under two minutes, occasionally up to around ten), coverage at the destination, top-ups, and exhausted data.
 - Explain and process requests under the 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy (full refund only if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated). Escalating anything that does not fit the policy.
 - Keep accurate notes, use approved macros, and flag repeating product, supplier, or documentation problems to the Customer Service Manager.
 - Treat every traveller with patience and clarity, including people who are in a hurry, offline at an airport, or not confident with phone settings.
 - Work in the team's live-chat and email tools, following the documented processes for each shift.
 Requirements
 - Experience in customer service, support, or a similar written-and-chat role, ideally in travel, e-commerce, telecom, or another digital consumer product.

About the Role: 
 At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. 
 What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 

- 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. 

- Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. 

- Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. 

- Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. 

- Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. 

 Qualification path
  What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): 

- Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). 

- Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. 

- English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. 

- Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. 

 Assessment: 
 In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. 
 Payment: 
 Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour 
 Our Payment terms are defined for each project. 
 Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: 

- Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

- Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

- Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

- Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. 

 Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.
 TELUS Digital AI Community 
 Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.
 Independent Contractor Relationship 
 This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

vacantes.descripcion:
Are you experienced in garment manufacturing quality control and interested in helping train the next generation of AI systems? As AI models are increasingly applied to global manufacturing, supply chain monitoring, and production analysis, their ability to reason about quality standards, inspection processes, and factory workflows depends on accurate, real-world training data. That training data begins with practitioners who understand how garments are actually produced and evaluated.
 We’re looking for Garment Manufacturing QC Specialists with hands-on experience inspecting garments and finished goods in factory or production environments. You’ll challenge AI models on real-world quality control scenarios involving defect identification, measurement tolerances, stitching quality, material consistency, finishing standards, and production compliance. This project focuses on evaluating how well models understand manufacturing workflows, common failure points, and quality decision-making at scale.
 On a typical day, you will review and discuss garment quality inspection scenarios with the model, verify whether model reasoning aligns with real factory QC practices, evaluate defect classification and severity assessment, analyze inspection workflows across production stages, capture recurring model errors, and suggest improvements to training prompts and evaluation criteria.
 General experience in garment manufacturing environments is ideal, including familiarity with sewing outputs, production lines, and inspection checkpoints. This project does not require advanced technical education; practical factory-floor experience in quality checking or garment inspection is strongly valued. Clear communication and the ability to explain quality judgments and production realities are essential.
 Ready to turn your garment manufacturing QC expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will help improve manufacturing quality worldwide.
 We offer a pay range of $6-to-$15 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
 Project Title: Garment Manufacturing QC Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
 Employment type: Freelance / Contract
 Workplace type: Remote

 All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

 Your routine responsibilities will include:

- Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

 Who are you?
 You areâ¦

To scale this impact, we are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager, AI & Automation to be a hands-on developer responsible for designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems to support a digital-first post-sales strategy.

 Key responsibilities include:

- Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.

- End-to-End Execution: Write code, execute experimental tests, and continuously maintain production solutions.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner across teams to ensure a cohesive experience for all users.

 Success is measured by key customer outcome metrics, including increased adoption, minimized churn risk, and higher NRR tied to the agents you deploy.

 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 

 You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. - Monitor: Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.

- Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara

 Qualifications

 Compensation

We maintain that diversity in all aspects leads to positive change, solutions and innovation for our customers and career fulfillment for our employees. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply! Side uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

 uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
 What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Enumerate is looking for a Staff Accountant to join our team! 

 As part of our goal to create and support the best community association management software, Enumerate offers accounting solutions for clients. As a Staff Accountant, you will be responsible for performing bank reconciliations and preparing financial statements for Enumerate’s Financial Services clients. This is a hands-on role that requires experience working in the HOA/COA industry. The ideal candidate has a strong attention to detail,, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven ability to leverage technology to improve efficiency, quality, and business outcomes.

 This is a contractor engagement eligible to applicants located in LATAM. 

 Key Responsibilities 

- Manage the monthly close: Record and review journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other adjustments; meet established close deadlines. 

- Reconcile accounts: Reconcile bank accounts, balance sheet accounts, and supporting schedules; research and resolve discrepancies. 

- Oversee A/P and A/R accuracy: Review transaction coding, payment activity, owner balances, deposits, and receivables for accuracy and proper supporting documentation. 

- Prepare financial statements: Produce and review monthly financial packages, including the balance sheet, income statement, general ledger, and supporting schedules. 

- Analyze financial results: Compare actual results to budget, identify unusual variances, and provide clear explanations to clients and management. 

- Maintain accurate records: Ensure transactions are posted to the correct association, account, and period, with complete documentation and an audit trail. 

- Support annual budgets and audits: Assist with budget preparation, audit requests, year-end schedules, and other client reporting needs. 

- Respond to client / internal questions: Explain financial results, research accounting issues, and coordinate timely resolutions with the appropriate EFS teams. 

- Follow controls and procedures: Apply EFS policies, client-specific requirements, and approval controls; escalate risks, errors, or recurring process issues. 

- Manage portfolio deadlines: Track deliverables across assigned communities and communicate early when information or action is needed to complete work on time. 

 Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting/appropriate field of study or comparable work experience 

- 3+ years of experience as a Staff Accountant

- Property management accounting experience is a bonus!

- Experience with creating financial statements, general ledger functions and the month-end/year end close process 

- Experience with accounting software

- Speed and accuracy are essential for this role which requires multiple financials prepared and issued daily

 Total monthly compensation:

 $2,700—$3,200 USD

Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

 We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed.

 You'll work directly with our design and consulting teams to turn mockups into fast, accessible, well-crafted websites for clients across a range of industries.

 What You'll Do

- 
 Build custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks (ACF or React-based), and plugins from provided designs

- 
 Translate mockups into responsive, accessible frontend code using HTML, CSS/SASS, and modern JavaScript

- 
 Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting

- 
 Diagnose and fix frontend and backend issues across a variety of CMS platforms

- 
 Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations

- 
 Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project.

 What You Bring

 Must-haves 

- 
 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals

- 
 3+ years building and customizing WordPress sites, including Gutenberg block development (ACF or React-based blocks)

- 
 Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently

- 
 Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work

- 
 Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git)

- 
 Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment

- 
 Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code.

 Nice-to-haves 

- 
 Experience with React or Angular

- 
 Laravel or Symfony

- 
 Docker and Linux environment familiarity

- 
 AWS or other cloud platform exposure

 Why Brafton

 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries.

 Compensation

 Plus commission

 Additional Information

🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring an Executive Assistant! 🌟
 Are you an AI-native operations expert with a talent for CRM administration and high-level executive support? We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant with an extreme ownership mindset to serve as the remote operations lead for a fast-moving commercial finance advisory firm!

 🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 

 🔗 

 🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift.

 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH. 

 📋 Job Details at a Glance 

- Job Title: Executive Assistant

- Job ID: ADAREG1EAR

- Industry: Financial Services

- Location: LATAM / South Africa

- Job Status: Full Time

- Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (EST)

- Salary: South Africa: $2,500 – $2,800 USD/month | Latin America: $1,900 – $2,200 USD/month

- Target Start Date: ASAP

 🏢 About the Client 

 Our client is a commercial finance advisory and brokerage based in South Florida, operating in the U.S. Eastern time zone. They originate and place the full spectrum of business financing — merchant cash advance, equipment finance, asset-based lending, factoring, SBA, commercial real estate, and lines of credit, through a network of 300+ lending partners. Led by a highly technical, forward-thinking owner, the culture runs on extreme ownership, sincere candor, and heavy use of automation and AI to remove manual work. This is a small, fast-moving team where a single strong operator has visible impact on the business.
 💼 About the Role 

 This is a critical, high-ownership remote operations role reporting directly to the CEO. Because our financial controller owns 100% of QuickBooks, payroll, and commissions, and our in-office EA owns brand/social, AI rollout, and physical office duties, you will own 100% of our remote daily administrative execution.
 Your domain includes CEO inbox/calendar/task triage, high-volume recruiting coordination, Close CRM day-to-day user & lead administration, phone number spam-flag remediation across 377+ numbers, lender portal & underwriting document chasing, and weekly accountability scoreboard preparation.
 🎯 Key Responsibilities 

 📧 1. Executive Support, Inbox Triage & Calendar/Tracker Ownership 

- Own daily triage of the CEO's inbox and admin inbox: draft replies, route items to the right owner, and follow through until closed.

- Manage the CEO's Google Calendar time-blocking and To-Do Tracker so every task has a due date and the simplest, smallest, most measurable next step.

- Handle personal administrative logistics for the CEO, including travel arrangements, vendor calls, and appointment scheduling.

 🤝 2. High-Volume Recruiting Coordination, Speed-Screen Scheduling & Onboarding Setup 

- Run day-to-day recruiting coordination across Indeed, LinkedIn, and JazzHR: post job ads, organize incoming applications, conduct sourcing outreach, and send candidate confirmations/reminders to eliminate no-shows.

vacantes.descripcion:
About FreedUp 

 FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
 About the role
 We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
 You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
 Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
 Location: Remote, LATAM
 Job Type: Full-time
 What you'll do
 1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

 2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

 3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

 4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

 5. Book travel

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

 6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

- Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

- Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

 Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.
 Our hiring process

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

 Requirements
 Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.

- High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.

- Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

 Nice-to-haves

- A good sense of humor and a likable personality.

- Experience with Notion as a CRM.

- Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.

- Sales operations or high-ticket sales support

 About the Role
 As a Bilingual Dental Virtual Assistant, you’ll take ownership of high-volume patient outreach, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and follow-up across both dental offices. Outbound calling is the core of this position, so you should genuinely enjoy speaking with patients and be comfortable spending much of your workday on the phone.
 Your immediate priorities will include verifying insurance, scheduling six-month recall appointments, following up with patients, and completing postoperative care calls. As you build trust and demonstrate strong performance, you’ll have the opportunity to take on marketing lead follow-up and potentially grow into treatment coordination or broader dental administrative responsibilities.
 Responsibilities

- Own a consistent outbound calling workflow for patient recalls, appointment confirmations, postoperative follow-ups, and other priority outreach.

- Verify dental insurance eligibility and coverage before appointments by contacting insurance providers and patients as needed.

- Follow up with patients to collect missing or incomplete insurance information and keep records accurate and up to date.

- Re-engage patients who are due or overdue for six-month checkups and cleanings and help convert outreach into scheduled appointments.

- Confirm upcoming appointments and coordinate accurate scheduling across both dental office locations.

- Complete postoperative care calls, document patient feedback, and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate dental team.

- Maintain clear, accurate call notes, insurance verification results, appointment updates, and follow-up records in the practice’s systems.

- Track outbound call activity, talk time, completed follow-ups, and other performance expectations consistently.

- Coordinate closely with office managers and administrative staff to keep patient communication organized across both practices.

- After training, follow up with prospective patients generated through Meta/Facebook campaigns, answer general questions, and help convert interested leads into attended appointments

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Fluent spoken English and Spanish with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with patients. 

- Experience in a dental, medical, patient coordination, reception, virtual assistant, or healthcare administrative environment. 

- Confidence performing high-volume outbound calling throughout the workday. 

- Experience scheduling patient appointments and maintaining accurate follow-up records. 

- Strong attention to detail when documenting patient conversations, insurance information, and scheduling updates. 

- Ability to handle confidential patient information appropriately and follow HIPAA requirements. 

- Hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, eligibility checks, and benefit confirmation. 

- Experience with outbound lead follow-up, appointment setting, or supporting a U.S.-based dental or medical practice remotely. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Familiarity with dental practice management software. 

- Experience using RingCentral or another web-based VoIP phone system..

Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM)
 Job Type: Contractor
 Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include:
 Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, Panama y Uruguay.
 Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.
 Key Responsibilities:

- Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities.

- Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data.

- Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards.

- Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.

- Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.

- Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.

 Required Skills and Qualifications:

- Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.

- Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.

- Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.

- Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.

- Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.

- Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.

- Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.

- 
 Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.

- Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.

- Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.

 Compensation Structure
 Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .
 Start Timeline & Availability
 We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding. 
 Equipment Requirements
 Mobile:
 Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.
 Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.
 IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
 Candidates who meet the project’s location and equipment requirements will be contacted soon to complete an identity verification process. Selected candidates should be able to complete this ID verification within 48 hours of being contacted. Successful verification is required before the contract can be issued for signature.

RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer. 

 About RainFocus 

 RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting.  

 About the Role 

 As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.
\n 

 How you will contribute: 

- 
 Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

- 
 Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

- 
 Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

- 
 Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

- 
 Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

- 
 Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.

 Required Experience/ Skills: 

- 
 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

- 
 Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

- 
 Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

- 
 Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

- 
 Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

- 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- 
 A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- 
 Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

- 
 Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

- 
 Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

- 
 Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

- 
 General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.

\n Why work at RainFocus? 

 At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

 Key responsibilities 

- Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

- Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

- Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

- Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

- Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

- Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

- Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

- Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

- Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

- Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

- Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

- Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

- A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

- Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

- Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

- A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

- A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

- Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

 You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ 

- Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfec

About Us
 We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health. 
 Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.
 By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. 
 We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.
 Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.
 We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where" .
 Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare. 

 Role overview
 Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

 What Youâll Do

- Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

- Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

- Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

- Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

- Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

- Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

 Accounts receivable and collections 

- Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

- Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

- Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

- Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

- Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

- Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

 Quality and team development 

- Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

- Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

- Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

 Basic Qualifications

- Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

- Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

- Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

- Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

- Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

- Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

- Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

- Ability

 About Pearl Talent 

 Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
 Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for: Watch here 

 About the Client
 A technology-driven healthcare company that helps organizations streamline operations and improve efficiency is looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with the Chief Operating Officer and keep executive priorities moving.
 The company is scaling, and the COO needs a hands-on partner to bring structure to executive workflows, project tracking, and reporting as the business grows.
 About the Role
 Day-to-day, the Chief of Staff manages the COO’s calendar and Outlook inbox, tracks commitments and deadlines, coordinates cross-functional projects, and supports administrative work for key client accounts, including billing documentation and compliance attestations. The role starts hands-on and expands into greater ownership of operational initiatives over time. Success at 90 days means independently running recurring administrative work, keeping critical deadlines visible, and making decisions without constant direction.
 Core Responsibilities
 Executive Support & Prioritization

- Manage the COO’s calendar, meetings, and competing priorities

- Run Outlook inbox management and executive follow-ups

- Track key commitments, deadlines, and action items

- Set up task-management systems that improve executive productivity

 Operations & Project Coordination

- Coordinate stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables across business functions

- Maintain project trackers, operational dashboards, and reports in Smartsheet and Excel

- Support administrative processes for corporate operations, compliance, and internal functions

- Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements

 Client & Stakeholder Coordination

- Support administrative and operational work for key client accounts

- Coordinate billing documentation, compliance attestations, and recurring client requests

- Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in English and Spanish

- Track outstanding client deliverables and support account performance reporting

 Reporting & Process Improvement

- Prepare clear updates on project status, priorities, and business performance

- Organize and visualize operational and financial data for leadership decisions

- Identify where AI, automation, and productivity tools can save time

- Take on ownership of operational initiatives as the role grows

 Requirements
 Must-Have

- 4+ years of experience in executive support, project management, business operations, consulting, or a similar execution-focused role

- Hands-on use of Microsoft Outlook for executive calendar and inbox management

- Microsoft Excel for reporting and tracking (pivot tables, dashboards, data organization)

- Experience building and maintaining project trackers or dashboards in Smartsheet

- Experience coordinating cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables

- At least one task-management, tracking, or process system built or improved, documented on CV

- C1+ English and C1+ Spanish (CEFR)

 Nice-to-Have

- Prior experience as a Chief of Staff or direct operational partner to a C-suite executive

- Experience in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated industry

- Background in management consulting, business operations, or operational transformation

- Experience with Todoist and AI-enabled productivity tools

- Experience supporting distributed teams or fast-growing organizations

 Benefits

- 
 Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills 

- 
 Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere 

- 
 Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting

-

 Our Recruitment Process 

- Application 

- Screening

This role sits at the heart of how Nash stabilizes the platform for our enterprise merchants - owning the investigation, resolution, and clean escalation of complex platform and integration issues across our delivery orchestration system.

About Us: 

 Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

 Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

 For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

 About the Role 

 Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it.

 You'll join an international support team that serves customers, partners, prospects, and internal colleagues. Our Tier 1 team provides round-the-clock support, while Tier 2 handles deeper technical investigations. This role brings additional engineering depth to that work, particularly in troubleshooting SDKs and complex payments integrations.

 This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly on difficult cases while helping teammates develop their technical skills. We also want this hire to help lay the foundation for a potential Tier 3 support function. That expansion and any future team leadership role are subject to leadership approval, rather than guaranteed next steps.

 We expect roughly 60% of your time to focus on complex customer tickets, most of them from our top-tier accounts. The remaining time will involve retrospectives, customer advocacy, cross-functional projects, and coaching.

 Responsibilities

- 
 Own complex technical investigations, particularly for our top-tier customer accounts. Read and navigate source code, analyze logs, and inspect API and SDK behavior to pinpoint issues.

- 
 Reproduce customer issues in test environments so findings are confirmed before they reach engineering.

- 
 Build clear, actionable engineering escalations that explain the problem, where it occurs, and potential approaches to resolving it, with engineering retaining final decisions on changes.

- 
 Bring SDK troubleshooting expertise to support for our Checkout SDK and share that knowledge across the team in collaboration with engineering.

- 
 Help manage incidents and keep customers informed, translating technical findings into clear explanations and advocating for their needs across departments.

- 
 Identify recurring patterns across cases, lead retrospectives, and turn findings into improvements that prevent repeat issues and reduce prolonged back-and-forth with engineering.

- 
 Improve documentation, share investigation techniques, and coach support teammates through unfamiliar technical problems.

- 
 Take ownership of cross-functional projects, from defining the problem through completing and rolling out the work.

- 

 Candidate Requirements

- 
 A foundation in software development through professional experience, coding education, or another hands-on path, with the ability to investigate code and explain technical findings.

- 
 Experience troubleshooting SDKs and working with APIs, including understanding how integrations behave in a web environment.

- 
 Customer-facing technical experience and the ability to communicate clearly with customers during complex or prolonged investigations.

- 
 The ability to coach others and lead work without formal authority. You don't need a previous management title, but you should be able to guide teammates and collaborate effectively with engineering.

- 
 Independent problem-solving and project ownership: you can work through ambiguity, move an investigation forward, and know when to bring others in.

- 
 Payments experience is strongly preferred because it will help you ramp quick

I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

 I started Anima to change that.

 Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

- 
 Make answers easier to find. Turn useful solutions into Help Centre articles, internal guidance and short walkthroughs.

- 
 Build the support function. Identify what’s holding the team back and own improvements—from how we measure quality and prioritise work to the systems, playbooks and automations we use. Test new approaches, see whether they work and help the whole team improve.

- 
 Bring customer insight into the business. Help Product understand where users struggle, and work with Implementation and Customer Success when an issue needs broader attention.

 Success means customers get accurate answers quickly, issues reach a clear resolution, and the team gets better at preventing or handling the next one.

 What you’ll bring

- 
 Practical problem-solving. Evidence of getting to the bottom of unfamiliar problems, testing possible explanations and finding a workable solution.

- 
 Clear, empathetic communication. The ability to explain a complicated issue simply, adapt to different levels of technical confidence and build trust with frustrated customers.

- 
 High agency and drive. Examples of improving a process or building something useful—and seeing it through.

- 
 Reliability under pressure. Good judgement about urgency, careful follow-through and the ability to manage several conversations without losing track.

- 
 Curiosity about how products work. An appetite for learning Anima in depth and working closely with engineers to resolve problems.

 Relevant experience could come from customer support, technical operations, implementation or another role involving complex products and direct customer interaction. Experience with support platforms or process automation is useful; your judgement and results matter more than familiarity

Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

 We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

 Director of Partnerships - Brazil

 About the Role

 The Global Partnerships team is seeking a seasoned professional to drive the strategy for our partner ecosystem in Brazil. As the Director, Partnerships, you will be a critical leader responsible for transforming how we engage, enable, and scale our regional partners, including Value-Added Resellers (VARs), Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), and Referral Partners. This is a builder’s role. You will be an integral part of an emerging LATAM team at Fastly, working alongside colleagues in Brazil to build our next emerging market through strategic, value-driven partner alliances.

 Your core mission will be to establish our platform as the foundational engine for partner growth in the region, enabling our partners to launch, sell, and support next-generation, margin-rich services built entirely on our modern platform. This role is about developing a high-impact, channel-first motion that drives recurring revenue, competitive differentiation, and long-term customer success for the partner. You will own the executive relationship, strategic vision, and overall business outcome for our key partners in Brazil.

 Responsibilities

 Ecosystem Strategy & Recruitment (The "Hunter" Motion)

- Market Mapping: Identify and recruit top-tier MSPs, MSSPs, and Systems Integrators in Brazil who specialize in Cloud Security, Content Delivery, and Edge Compute.

- Vertical Alignment: Target partners specifically equipped to serve our high-performing verticals, ensuring they understand Fastly's competitive advantage over legacy providers.

- Deal Structuring: Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements that support various partner models (Resell, Managed Service, Referral, Distributor and Cloud Marketplaces), ensuring mutual profitability and long-term alignment.

 Partner Growth & Co-Innovation (The "Farmer" Motion)

- Joint Business Planning (JBP): Lead executive-level planning sessions with key partners to align their service portfolios with Fastly’s product roadmap.

- Service Creation: Collaborate with partners to build unique, "Powered by Fastly" offerings—such as Managed WAF, Advanced Edge Compute solutions, or Observability platforms—that generate new recurring revenue streams for them.

- Executive Alignment: Own the C-level relationships (CEO, CTO, CISO) within our partner organizations, acting as their trusted advisor and executive sponsor within Fastly.

 Go-to-Market & Enablement

- Sales Activation: Collaborate with Partner Marketing to create scalable sales playbooks and GTM programs that drive consumption within the partner’s field sales teams.

- Enablement: Ensure partner technical and sales teams are fully certified and capable of positioning Fastly’s full portfolio—moving beyond basic delivery to advanced security and compute solutions.

- Pipeline Management: oversee the partner pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and healthy deal flow across the region.

 Advocacy & Leadership

- Internal Evangelist: Serve as the "Voice of Brazilian Partners" internally, synthesizing market feedback and competitive intelligence (specifically vs. legacy CDN/Security competitors) to inform Fastly’s Product and Sales leadership.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.

Hello! 

 I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby . I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 

 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

 Not sure which Support role is right for you? 

 We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. 

- 
 Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

- 
 Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

 Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

 About the role 

 Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

 You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

- 
 Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

- 
 Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

- 
 Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

- 
 Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

- 
 Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

- 
 Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

- 
 Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

 You should apply if: 

- 
 You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

- 
 You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

- 
 You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

- 
 You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

- 
 You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

- 
 You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

 You should not apply if: 

- 
 You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

- 
 Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deplo

About Pleo 

 Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

 The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

 Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

 About the role: 

 We're looking for a Digital Onboarding Solutions Specialist to join our Digital Onboarding Solutions team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help customers who have got stuck while onboarding themselves onto Pleo, unblock them, and make sure they get to a successful first spend. You'll also help us find and fix the friction that causes these blockers in the first place. If you enjoy solving real problems for real people, and you care about making onboarding work better for everyone, then this is the opportunity for you!

 Who you'll be working with and reporting to 

 You'll report to our Manager, Onboarding and work closely with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to getting every new customer to a smooth, successful start on Pleo. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Growth, Sales, Support and RevOps to remove friction for our customers.

 What you'll be doing 

 As a Digital Onboarding Solutions Specialist, you will:

- 
 Monitor escalation channels, handle live chats during coverage hours, diagnose blockers, and agree next steps with customers.

- 
 Pick up Freshdesk tickets raised outside live chat hours, reply by email the next business morning, and offer a call when needed.

- 
 Schedule and run calls with customers who are blocked during self-onboarding and have escalated via chat or email.

- 
 Coordinate internally on specialist escalation consultations and take ownership of seeing each case through to resolution.

- 
 Record the stage, blocker and outcome for every account, and run 1–2 week progress checks to keep customers moving.

- 
 Work closely with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager to improve our processes by flagging inefficiencies and proposing fixes.

- 
 Run proactive outreach on stalled accounts before they churn or give up.

 What you bring 

 You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- 
 Experience in customer support, customer success, onboarding or another role where you help people get unstuck quickly.

- 
 A clear, structured approach to diagnosing problems: you ask the right questions, find the real blocker, and agree a next step.

- 
 Confidence running calls with customers, including those who are frustrated or short on time. • Strong attention to detail and the discipline to record stage, blocker and outcome consistently.

- 
 A continuous improvement mindset, and the willingness to raise inefficiencies and help fix them with others.

- 
 Comfort working across different channels (live chat, email, calls) and managing your own queue.

- 
 Working hours are 9am–5pm.

 Why is this role a good fit for you 

 This role is a good fit for you if:

- 
 You get satisfaction from turning a stuck customer into a happy one.

- 
 You like spotting patterns, asking why something keeps going wrong, and doing something about it.

- 
 You are organised and enjoy owning a caseload from start to finish.

- 
 This role is not a good fit for you if:

- 
 You prefer to work without regular contact with customers.

- 
 You find it hard to switch between many open cases and channels in a single day.

 How you'll develop in this role 

 In your first several weeks at Pleo, you'll:

- 
 Build deep knowledge of Pleo's product and the most common onboarding blockers, so you can resolve cases faster.

- 
 Take ownership of your own caseload and proactive outreach to stalled accounts.

- 
 Work with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager and cross-functional partners to improve a process or flow that is blocking customers. We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on more complex escalations, stepping into a Team Lead role, or building new skills in onboarding design, product, marketing, and digital funnel building.
